why: Owner's request: kids cartoon with a cat and a dog in Urdu, set in a Pakistani home. Few quality Urdu animated kids channels.

series.name: Mano aur Sheru
series.style: 3D animated family film look, colourful Pakistani house with a courtyard (sehan), a neem tree, rooftop and busy mohalla street, soft sunlight, rounded friendly shapes, vertical 9:16 frame

characters.name: Mano
characters.look: Mano, a white kitten with orange patches, bright blue eyes and a tiny bell on a red ribbon

characters.name: Sheru
characters.look: Sheru, a brave brown desi dog with a white chest, pointy ears and a green collar

rules: Narration in simple, polite Urdu for children, in Urdu script.
Everyday Pakistani life: home, rooftop, mohalla, bazaar, park, school gate, family.
Mano is curious and sometimes naughty; Sheru is brave, loyal and kind. They are best friends.
Every episode has one small lesson; nothing scary or violent.
The last shot says the lesson in one short line and teases the next episode.

topics: Mano and Sheru meet for the first time in the courtyard and become friends.
A hot summer afternoon: they put a bowl of water on the rooftop for thirsty birds.
Getting ready for Eid: new clothes, sweets and sharing happiness with everyone.
Mano spills the milk and tells the truth instead of hiding it.
The first rain of the monsoon: making paper boats in the street.
They share their food with a hungry stray cat in the mohalla.
Sheru helps a lost little boy find his way back home.
Mano is afraid of the dark; Sheru helps her with a torch and a story.
Mango season: waiting patiently for the mangoes to ripen.
Lost in the bazaar: why it is important to remember your home address.
The electricity goes out: the whole family tells stories by lamplight.
Street cricket: winning and losing while staying friends.
Ramzan: helping prepare iftar with fruit chaat and pakoras.
Don't waste water: Mano learns to close the dripping tap.
One year of friendship: Mano and Sheru remember their best moments.
moreIdeas: Kite season: Sheru keeps Mano away from sharp kite string on the rooftop (safety first).
Cleaning day: they help tidy the courtyard and put rubbish in the bin.
A train journey to Nani's house in the village.
Sheru gets a new ball and learns to share it with all the street children.
Planting a little neem tree and caring for it every day.
Mano's birthday: a small celebration that makes everyone happy.
Sheru stays quiet while Dada Jaan is sleeping: respecting elders.
The new neighbour's dog: from jealousy to friendship.
Mano hides in the school bag, but learns that school is for children and waits at home.
A sparrow's nest on the veranda: they learn not to disturb it.
Sheru is scared of the injection at the vet, and Mano holds his paw until he is brave.
Mano visits a bookshop and discovers how much fun reading is.
The shopkeeper gives Ammi too much change, and Mano and Sheru help return it honestly.
Mano and Sheru remind Dadi Amma to take her medicine on time: helping elders.
A trip to the zoo: they learn never to tease or feed the animals.
